description: This Perl module 'Git::LoadCPAN' provides a wrapper to load modules from either the system's CPAN installation or a bundled copy within the Git project. It defines constants, performs conditional module loading, and manages fallback mechanisms for module importation.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Handles the dynamic loading of a specified module, attempting to require it and providing fallback mechanisms if it is not found; also injects import behavior into caller namespace.
